name: Hakuouki Shinkai: Ginsei no Shou
original_name: 薄桜鬼 真改 銀星ノ抄
source:
Fandisc to Hakuouki Shinkai that focuses on the after stories of the following cast of characters: Saito, Heisuke, Harada, Shinpachi, Soma and Sakamoto.

[from [url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2019/01/08/2019-overview-upcoming-otome-bl-games/]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
translation:
《薄樱鬼真改》的粉丝向资料片，聚焦斋藤、平助、原田、新八、相马和坂本等角色的后日谈。

[来源：[url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2019/01/08/2019-overview-upcoming-otome-bl-games/]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
